Subject: Interested in Redwood - quick demo?

Hi Sophie —

I noticed you started a trial with Redwood yesterday — thanks for checking us out. I’m Jordan on the SDR team and I help schedule short demos to make sure folks see the right parts of the product. Before we lock something in, could you share a few quick details so I can make the demo most useful?

- Primary use case you’re exploring (e.g., summarization, triage, clinical coding)
- Expected monthly token/requests volume (ballpark)
- Timeline to pilot / production (this quarter, next quarter, six months+)
- Any compliance constraints (PHI/PCI/SOC2/BAA required?)
- Who will join the demo (technical role vs product/stakeholder)

I can do a 30-minute live demo (customized to your use case). A few slots I have next week (PT):
- Thu Jun 12: 10:00–11:00 or 10:30–11:00
- Fri Jun 13: 14:00–15:00
Or feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-30min

If you prefer an intro call with one of our AEs, I can loop them in.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
SDR, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
